source.failure: Deployment and CI release guards require a Flutter debug APK build absent from ci-flutter.yaml; Android Release then waits for an unavailable self-hosted Windows runner. No signed APK reached GitHub Releases.

fix: Build and retain a debug APK in the reusable Flutter CI workflow; build and retain three signed release APKs on a GitHub-hosted Ubuntu runner before publishing the release assets.

checks.name: Android debug APK workflow artifact
checks.observation: CI #66 passed and uploaded boohtacord-android-debug-apk containing desktop/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-debug.apk.

checks.name: Signed Android release APKs
checks.observation: Quality, signed ABI-specific build, workflow artifact upload, and GitHub Release publication passed. GitHub Release API reports all three APK assets uploaded with Android package MIME type.

checks.name: Production deploy
checks.observation: Deploy #21 passed backend, frontend, release_guard, guarded rollout, pinned image verification, public /api/v1/health check, and attachment headroom audit.

limitation: The local Mac has Flutter 3.47.5 but no Android SDK. The APK builds and release assets were verified on GitHub runners; physical-device installation was not part of this check.
